notes: S2/F57/F66 (§12.2 1a, decided by principle as X.690 in full for the universal types it names): the receipt gains one unregistered unsigned attribute (an open type, judged by its framing and the universal rules of 1a only); the value is 00 00: universal tag number 0 (end-of-contents), which X.690 reserves for the indefinite form; DER never contains it. The receipt is otherwise fully re-signed with the test TSA key.
